answer: Social Matters >> Nikah (Marriage) Question ID: 8311 Country: Pakistan Title: Is it allowed to have intercourse with your on 1st or 15th or the last night of an islamic moth. because i was told no to do it in these three days of an islamic month? Question: Is it allowed to have intercourse with your on 1st or 15th or the last night of an islamic moth. because i was told no to do it in these three days of an islamic month? Answer ID: 8311 Posted on: Aug 30, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1955/1558=H/1429) It is lawful (without any desirability) to have intercourse on 1 st and 15 th nights of a month. What you have heard is false and unreliable. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
